plan064_defects_eliminated.D1: Router Hash now treated as 64-lowercase-hex SHA-256 (32-byte I2P IdentHash); the 40-hex SHA-1 contract is rejected.
plan064_defects_eliminated.D2: Transport static key is now selected from the NTCP2 RouterAddress used for the target endpoint and hashed from its `s` field; the SSU2 accessor cannot satisfy the validation.
plan064_defects_eliminated.D3: Initialization is now the source-verified pinned sequence: config::Init, context::ParseConfig, fs::SetAppDir, crypto::Init, context::Init, transport singleton, netdb.Start, transports.Start(true, false), context.Start; shutdown is the strict reverse order.
plan064_defects_eliminated.D4: Dial mode now constructs a real CreateDeliveryStatusMsg(delivery_status_message_id) and submits through Transports::SendMessage exactly once; the null-message trigger is removed.
plan064_defects_eliminated.D5: Initial null session is no longer classified as final failure; the driver waits boundedly for the established TransportSession state and exact sender observer completion.
plan064_defects_eliminated.D6: Reserved-range rejection is disabled through the rendered i2pd configuration for the sealed synthetic topology; every other target validation remains in force.
plan064_defects_eliminated.D7: The passive observer reports the exact decoded DeliveryStatus message ID and peer Router Hash after AEAD verification and FromNTCP2 conversion; generic log phrases cannot satisfy the receive path.
plan064_defects_eliminated.D8: Every source, patch, compiler, library, and binary input is bound by measured SHA-256 digests in source-lock.json and the build manifest; all-zero or placeholder digests fail closed.
